name: Photos
description: PhotoStation for your NAS: a timeline of every photo and video on your shares, albums, favourites, a private PIN-protected section and a full-screen viewer. The gallery index stays in EthOS (the Android Moments app reads it too); this package ships the desktop app, so it can update on its own.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: Add folder uses the EthOS folder picker, and moving items to trash reports progress in the shared task panel. 1.0.0: first release. The Photos desktop app moves out of the core install into Package Center; the gallery index, albums and private section keep living in EthOS, so the Android Moments app is unaffected and photos are still indexed without this package.
